notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for joined-federate MOM reflections-received counts. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, HLAvariableArray, HLAfixedRecord, HLAinteger32BE, HLAbyte, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application object/attribute names. It verifies reliable and best-effort attribute-reflection accounting, nested MOM data-element decoding, receiver metadata, attribute-transportation confirmation, empty-response boundaries, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM reflection-count and transportation-change services with FederateAmbassador discovery, reflection, interaction, and confirmation callbacks
